svg.aria-label: The host's screen reaches the annotator through any screen-sharing app. On the annotator's PC, Remote Pointer's target area is moved and resized until it matches the shared image; pressing Start turns its border red and begins annotating. Three clicks and a circle drawn around a block of code then appear a moment later on the host's real screen, each fading on its own.
svg.title: Remote Pointer — how a session runs
